full_prompt_en: A square, loosely brushed city painting shows a rain-wet boulevard at dusk. An old streetcar approaches near the center, its warm amber interior glowing through front windows. Dark pedestrians in coats crowd the left sidewalk and gather around the vehicle; another dark carriage or vehicle moves beside it. The road opens wide toward the lower edge, where pale gray pavement is broken by long vertical streaks of gold and orange reflection. Thin rail lines and darker tire tracks draw the eye back into the busy middle distance. A row of multistory stone buildings recedes from the right foreground toward the left distance. At street level, shopfronts and café lights form a nearly continuous belt of orange and yellow against cool gray facades. Streetlamps make small brilliant points along the boulevard. Bare tree branches trace fine black lines into the hazy sky, and high windows gleam faintly above the crowds. The far end of the avenue dissolves into mist, with silhouettes, lights, and architecture compressed into soft marks. Brushwork stays broken and energetic: broad wet-looking strokes carry the roadway, while smaller dark dabs indicate figures and architectural details. Light is predominantly artificial and low, spreading as broken reflections across puddles rather than casting clean shadows. The palette is slate gray, charcoal, muted blue, ocher, and molten orange. A central moving vehicle and converging street lines give the scene depth, while scattered luminous marks create the lively rhythm of a crowded evening street.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、笔触松动的城市绘画呈现黄昏雨后的湿大道。一辆旧式电车从中央附近驶来，前窗透出温暖琥珀色车厢灯光。穿大衣的深色行人挤在左侧人行道，也聚集在车旁；另一辆深色马车或车辆与它并行。道路朝下缘宽阔展开，浅灰路面被金橘色的长竖向倒影切开。细轨道线和更深的车辙把目光引回繁忙中景。一排多层石建筑从右前方退向左远处。街面店铺与咖啡馆灯火在冷灰立面前连成几乎连续的橘黄光带。路灯沿大道形成几个明亮小点。裸树枝以细黑线伸进朦胧天空，高处窗户在拥挤人群上方微微发亮。大道尽头溶入雾气，剪影、灯光和建筑压缩成柔和笔痕。笔法断裂而活跃：宽阔、仿佛湿润的笔触铺出路面，较小深色点笔指示人影和建筑细节。光主要来自低处人工灯火，以碎裂倒影铺在积水里，而非投下干净阴影。配色包含板岩灰、炭黑、低饱和蓝、赭色和熔金般的橘色。中央移动的车辆与汇聚的街道线建立纵深，散开的发亮笔点则构成拥挤夜街的活泼节奏。
style_prompt_en: A loose urban oil-painting surface places warm incandescent accents within a cool gray-blue and charcoal field. Broad horizontal and diagonal strokes establish receding planes, while long broken vertical smears in the lower zone suggest wet reflections. Small dark dabs gather into lively clusters without precise individual detail. Upper forms recede through haze and softened edges; near silhouettes and a central illuminated shape remain firmer. Thin linear marks cut through broad paint to guide depth, and fine branchlike tracery adds rhythm above the denser middle band. Light appears in scattered ocher, gold, and orange points that bleed slightly into surrounding gray. The contrast between compressed busy marks and an open reflective foreground creates space. Surface texture is brisk and visibly brushed, with restrained details and an atmospheric, rain-damp luminosity.
style_prompt_zh: 松动的城市油画表面把温暖白炽灯色重音嵌进冷灰蓝与炭黑色域。宽阔水平及斜向笔触建立后退的平面，下部区域破碎的长竖向擦痕暗示湿润倒影。细小深色点笔聚成活跃簇群，不精确刻画个体。上部形体经过雾气和软边后退；近处剪影与中央受光形体则更坚实。细线穿过宽阔颜料引导纵深，枝状细纹在更密集的中景色带上方加入节奏。光以零散赭色、金色和橘色点出现，微微渗进周围灰色。拥挤的压缩笔痕与开阔反光前景之间的对照创造空间。表面肌理迅捷且笔触可见，细节克制，带有雨后潮湿空气的光感。
theme_en: An evening streetcar crossing a rain-wet city boulevard
theme_zh: 暮色中有电车驶过的雨后城市大道
name: Edouard Cortes
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
